## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] A changeset is included, or this change does not affect a published package
- [ ] If this touches export: a deck round-trips and opens in real PowerPoint with no repair prompt
- [ ] If this was informed by a copyleft implementation, it is disclosed above (see [LEGAL.md](../LEGAL.md))
